verdict.rationale: Lindy is a SaaS AI-teammate platform that could plausibly publish a developer API reference, so this axis applies. The evidence shows no interactive API reference or runnable examples, and every probed OpenAPI/Swagger path returned 404. The docs only describe Lindy itself consuming other tools' APIs and MCP servers, which is a different capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
